title: Build the iHRIS-themed harness site
description: Generates the static site published at litlfred.github.io/ihris/ from committed, schema-validated data. It covers: a landing board of every instance; the data model per package and class, in the accepted wireframe H2 layout; the Launchpad sources, with series, releases (MD5), every I2CE module and the shipped data lists; iHRIS 5 as a pinned inventory; the toolkit as structure only (no licence recorded); the wiki help pages in full (GPL), with their figures and rewritten links; the data dictionary, with logical models, value sets and codes, and ISO/ISCO reports; iHRIS 4 on FHIR; and the schema index. It is themed with src/site/theme/ihris-classic.json, and all links are relative. --check-links fails on any internal link that does not resolve. Needs markdown==3.7 (src/tools/requirements-site.txt).
